title: Zero-free half-planes from Chebyshev bounds on windows
summary: A one-sided bound $G_K(x)\le x^{\theta}$ for a positive combination $G_K$ of the twisted Chebyshev sums $\sum_{n\le x}\Lambda(n)\chi(n)(x/n-1)$, corrected by their main terms, implies $L(s,\chi)\neq0$ for $\operatorname{Re}s>\theta$, even when the bound is known only on windows $[Y,Y^{\lambda}]$ for arbitrarily large $Y$. The proof is a quantitative form of Landau's theorem; the positivity it needs is that a real zero contributes a pole with positive residue to the Laplace transform. The chapter ends with the reduction of the half-plane statement for a primitive character $\psi$ to window bounds with exponent $1/2+O(\varepsilon)$ for the cyclic group generated by $\psi$, which the remaining chapters supply.
progress: Completion pass done: Definition wl-corrected-sums cites Definitions mt-dirichlet-character and mt-l-function; families are indexed by their exponent epsilon.

statements.statement: Let $K$ be a finite set of primitive Dirichlet characters that contains the trivial character and is closed under $\chi\mapsto\bar\chi$. Let $o\ge0$ be an integer, and let $\psi_K$ be either absent or a real odd character in $K$. The weighted Chebyshev sum of these data is $G_K(y)=G(y)+\sum_{\chi\in K,\ \chi\ne1}w_\chi\operatorname{Re}g_\chi(y)$, with $w_{\psi_K}=1$ and $w_\chi=(3o+1)^{-1}$ for every other $\chi$. Here $G(y)=\sum_{n\le y}\Lambda(n)(y/n-1)-y\log y+(1+\gamma)y$ and, for a nontrivial character $\chi$, $g_\chi(y)=\sum_{n\le y}\Lambda(n)\chi(n)(y/n-1)+y\,\frac{L'}{L}(1,\chi)$; for the character modulo $1$ put $g_1=G$.
statements.label: wl-weighted-sum

statements.statement: Let $\psi$ be a primitive Dirichlet character. Its cyclic level is the set $K_\psi$ of primitive characters that induce the elements of the cyclic group $\langle\psi\rangle$ of Dirichlet characters, with $o=|\langle\psi\rangle|$ and no exceptional character. Thus $G_{K_\psi}(y)=G(y)+\frac{1}{3o+1}\sum_{\chi\in K_\psi,\ \chi\neq1}\operatorname{Re}g_\chi(y)$, and $\psi\in K_\psi$.
statements.label: wl-cyclic-level

statements.reference: Ingham, The Distribution of Prime Numbers, Chapter IV; Davenport, Multiplicative Number Theory, Chapters 12 and 17
statements.statement: Let $(\chi_i,a_i)_{i\in I}$ be a finite family of Dirichlet characters and real numbers $a_i>0$, where each $\chi_i$ is nontrivial or has modulus $1$, and let $g(u)=\sum_i a_i\operatorname{Re}g_{\chi_i}(e^u)$. Then $|g(u)|\le Ce^{2u}$ for $u\ge0$, and the Laplace transform $\Phi(s)=\int_0^\infty g(u)e^{-su}\,du$, defined for $\operatorname{Re}s>2$, extends to a holomorphic function on $\{\operatorname{Re}s>0\}\setminus Z$. Here $Z$ is the set of $\rho$ with $\operatorname{Re}\rho>0$ such that $L(\rho,\chi_i)=0$ or $L(\bar\rho,\chi_i)=0$ for some $i$. The set $Z$ is discrete in the half-plane, and every $\rho\in Z$ is a simple pole of $\Phi$ with nonzero residue, which is real and positive when $\rho$ is real. Here $G(y)=\sum_{n\le y}\Lambda(n)(y/n-1)-y\log y+(1+\gamma)y$ and, for a nontrivial character $\chi$, $g_\chi(y)=\sum_{n\le y}\Lambda(n)\chi(n)(y/n-1)+y\,\frac{L'}{L}(1,\chi)$; for the character modulo $1$ put $g_1=G$.
statements.label: wl-pole-data-family

statements.statement: Let $g:\mathbf R\to\mathbf R$ be measurable with $|g(u)|\le Ce^{2u}$ for $u\ge0$, and let $\Phi(s)=\int_0^\infty g(u)e^{-su}\,du$ for $\operatorname{Re}s>2$. Let $Z\subset\{\operatorname{Re}s>0\}$ be discrete in that half-plane, and suppose that $\Phi$ extends holomorphically to $\{\operatorname{Re}s>0\}\setminus Z$ with a simple pole of nonzero residue at each $\rho\in Z$, the residue being real and positive when $\rho$ is real. Let $0<\theta<1$ and $\delta>0$. Suppose that for every $\eta>0$ and every $U_0$ there are $U\ge U_0$ and a function $R\ge0$ on $[U,(1+\delta)U]$ with $g\le R$ there and $\int_U^{(1+\delta)U}R(u)e^{-\theta u}\,du\le e^{\eta U}$. Then $\operatorname{Re}\rho\le\theta$ for every $\rho\in Z$.
statements.label: wl-landau-window

statements.statement: Let $(\chi_i,a_i)_{i\in I}$ be a finite family of Dirichlet characters and real numbers $a_i>0$, each $\chi_i$ nontrivial or of modulus $1$. Let $0<\theta<1$, $\delta>0$ and $C\in\mathbf R$. Suppose that for every $Y_0$ there is $Y\ge Y_0$ such that $\sum_i a_i\operatorname{Re}g_{\chi_i}(y)\le Cy^{\theta}$ for all $y\in[Y,Y^{1+\delta}]$. Then $L(s,\chi_i)\neq0$ for every $i$ and every $s$ with $\operatorname{Re}s>\theta$. Here $G(y)=\sum_{n\le y}\Lambda(n)(y/n-1)-y\log y+(1+\gamma)y$ and, for a nontrivial character $\chi$, $g_\chi(y)=\sum_{n\le y}\Lambda(n)\chi(n)(y/n-1)+y\,\frac{L'}{L}(1,\chi)$; for the character modulo $1$ put $g_1=G$.
statements.label: wl-zero-free-family

statements.statement: Let $K$, $o$ and $\psi_K$ be as in the definition of $G_K$. Let $\lambda>1$ and $0<\theta<1$. Suppose that for every $y$ there is $Y\ge y$ such that $G_K(x)\le x^{\theta}$ for all $x\in[Y,Y^{\lambda}]$. Then $L(s,\chi)\neq0$ for every $\chi\in K$ and every $s$ with $\operatorname{Re}s>\theta$.
statements.label: wl-zero-free-level

statements.statement: Let $K$ be a level and $\lambda$ real, and let classes of families of definite-side data with sets of scales $W_F$ and a tied condition be given. Suppose that: (1) for all real $e_D,e_L$, every $\varepsilon>0$ and every family that satisfies the host conditions for $K$ and is tied on its scales with exponents $e_D,e_L$, there is $x_1$ with $G_K(x)\le x^{1/2+(e_D+e_L+7)\varepsilon}$ for all $x\ge x_1$ in $W_F$; (2) there are $e_D,e_L$ and $\varepsilon_1>0$ such that for every $\varepsilon\in(0,\varepsilon_1)$ such a family exists whose set of scales has windows of exponent $\lambda$; (3) for every $0<\theta<1$, if $\{x:G_K(x)\le x^\theta\}$ has windows of exponent $\lambda$ then no $L(s,\chi)$ with $\chi\in K$ vanishes for $\operatorname{Re}s>\theta$. Then $L(s,\chi)\neq0$ for every $\chi\in K$ and $\operatorname{Re}s>1/2$. Condition (3) holds for $\lambda>1$ by the theorem for levels.
statements.label: wl-level-from-windows

statements.statement: Let $Q$ be a set of primitive Dirichlet characters and let $\lambda>1$. Suppose that for every $\psi\in Q$ the cyclic level $K_\psi$ satisfies conditions (1) and (2) of the previous statement with this $\lambda$, and condition (3) for every exponent $\lambda'>1$. Then $L(s,\psi)\neq0$ for every $\psi\in Q$ and every $s$ with $\operatorname{Re}s>1/2$.
statements.label: wl-zero-free-cyclic

statements.statement: For a nontrivial Dirichlet character $\chi$, $g_\chi(y)=\sum_{1\le n\le y}\Lambda(n)\chi(n)(y/n-1)+y\frac{L'}{L}(1,\chi)$; for the trivial character modulo $1$, $g_1(y)=G(y)=\sum_{1\le n\le y}\Lambda(n)(y/n-1)-y\log y+(1+\gamma)y$.
statements.label: wl-corrected-sums

statements.statement: A character family is a finite family $(\chi_i,a_i)$ of Dirichlet characters, each nontrivial or of modulus $1$, with weights $a_i>0$; its weighted Chebyshev sum is $G_F=\sum_ia_i\operatorname{Re}g_{\chi_i}$ and its zero set $Z_F$ is the set of $\rho$ with $\operatorname{Re}\rho>0$ and $L(\rho,\chi_i)=0$ or $L(\bar\rho,\chi_i)=0$ for some $i$.
statements.label: wl-character-family

statements.statement: A level is a finite set $K$ of primitive Dirichlet characters containing the trivial one and closed under conjugation, an optional exceptional character $\psi_K\in K$ that is odd and real, and an integer $o\ge0$.
statements.label: wl-level

statements.statement: For $\chi$ nontrivial or trivial modulo $1$ and $\operatorname{Re}s>1$, $\int_0^\infty g_\chi(e^u)e^{-su}du=-(\frac{L'}{L}(s,\chi)-s\frac{L'}{L}(1,\chi))/(s(s-1))$, respectively $-(\frac{\zeta'}{\zeta}(s)+\frac1{s-1}+1-(1+\gamma)s)/(s(s-1))$. This extends meromorphically, is holomorphic at $s=1$, and at a zero $\rho\neq0$ of order $m$ has residue $-m/(\rho(\rho-1))$.
statements.label: wl-laplace-character

statements.statement: Pole data $(g,\Phi,Z)$: $g$ measurable with $|g(u)|\le C_0e^{2u}$ for $u\ge0$; $\Phi$ its Laplace transform for $\operatorname{Re}s>2$; $Z$ in the right half-plane without accumulation points there; $\Phi$ holomorphic on the half-plane off $Z$, with a simple pole of nonzero residue at each $\rho\in Z$, real and positive when $\rho$ is real.
statements.label: wl-pole-data

statements.statement: $g$ satisfies the window hypothesis with exponent $\theta$ and width $\delta$ if for every $\eta>0$ and $U_0$ there are $U\ge U_0$ and $R\ge0$ on $[U,(1+\delta)U]$ with $g\le R$ there and $\int_U^{(1+\delta)U}R(u)e^{-\theta u}du\le e^{\eta U}$.
statements.label: wl-window-hypothesis

statements.statement: For $\delta>0$ there are $\sigma>2$ and $C_1$ such that for every $U\ge1$ some integer $k\ge U$ has $\int_{(0,\infty)\setminus[U,(1+\delta)U]}u^ke^{-(\sigma-2)u}/k!\,du\le C_1\sigma^{-k}$.
statements.label: wl-kernel-tails

statements.statement: Under the hypotheses of the windowed Landau theorem, with $a_k(s)=(-1)^k\Phi^{(k)}(s)/k!$, there are $\sigma>2$ and $C$ such that for every $\eta>0$ and $U_0$ some $U\ge U_0$ and integer $k\ge U$ satisfy $|a_k(\sigma+i\gamma)|+\operatorname{Re}a_k(\sigma)\le Ce^{\eta U}(\sigma-\theta)^{-k}$ for all real $\gamma$.
statements.label: wl-coefficient-bound

statements.statement: If $Z$ has no accumulation point in the right half-plane, $0<\theta<\sigma$, $\operatorname{Re}\rho<\sigma$ on $Z$ and some $\rho_0\in Z$ has $\operatorname{Re}\rho_0>\theta$, then either some $\sigma+i\gamma$ has a unique nearest point of $Z$ within a disc of radius $r\le D\le\sigma-\theta$ while $B(\sigma,D)$ misses $Z$, or the nearest point of $Z$ to $\sigma$ is a real $\beta>\theta$, alone in a disc of radius $r\le\sigma-\theta$ about $\sigma$ (with landau_nearest).
statements.label: wl-nearest-pole

statements.statement: Cauchy's estimates: for $\Phi$ holomorphic on $B(z,r)$ the Taylor coefficients at $z$ are $O(r'^{-k})$ for $r'<r$; with a simple pole of residue $c$ at $\rho\in B(z,r)\setminus\{z\}$, $(-1)^k\Phi^{(k)}(z)/k!-c(z-\rho)^{-k-1}=O(r'^{-k})$ (with landau_cauchy).
statements.label: wl-pole-coefficients

statements.statement: If $G_F(y)\le Cy^\theta$ on $[Y,Y^{1+\delta}]$ for arbitrarily large $Y$, then $u\mapsto G_F(e^u)$ satisfies the window hypothesis with exponent $\theta$ and width $\delta$ (with windowHypU_of_windowHyp).
statements.label: wl-power-window

statements.statement: A set $S\subset\mathbf R$ has windows of exponent $\lambda$ if for every $y$ there is $Y\ge y$ with $[Y,Y^\lambda]\subset S$.
statements.label: wl-windows

statements.statement: Situation: for each $\varepsilon>0$ a class of families of definite-side data with sets of scales $W_F$ and an arbitrary tied condition; a family is tied on its scales with exponents $(e_D,e_L)$ if for some constants it is tied at every large $x\in W_F$, and satisfies the host conditions for a level $K$ if every member at every large $x$ does at $(x,\varepsilon,C)$ for some $C$.
statements.label: wl-families

statements.statement: A level $K$ has the Chebyshev bound along tied families if every family satisfying the host conditions for $K$ and tied with exponents $(e_D,e_L)$ has $G_K(x)\le x^{1/2+(e_D+e_L+7)\varepsilon}$ at its large scales; it has tied families with windows of exponent $\lambda$ if for all small $\varepsilon$ such a family exists whose set of scales has windows of exponent $\lambda$ (with ChebyshevInequalityAtWindowScale).
statements.label: wl-family-conditions
